audit_findings: First-half threat underestimated: Manchester United generated 1.01 xG to Chelsea 0.28 at HT, so a Chelsea-result preference was not evidence of first-half tactical superiority.
HT over 1.0 conditional idea lost mathematically at 0-0; lack of actual 1.75 quote means do not count it as lost monetary bet or approved pick.
First-half dangerous chances or disallowed goals cannot substitute for settled goals; VAR and offside must exclude phantom goals.
Red card at 63 and subsequent penalty at 64 were high-impact post-kickoff changes and not predictable sealed pre-match evidence.
Correct-score 2-1 was wrong (2-0), despite correct Chelsea result direction; do not declare total predictive success.
A different public xG source reported 2.11-1.18 versus FotMob 2.67-1.17; xG must be labeled by provider and time and should not be cross-pooled.
Predicted lineup 3-4-2-1 in prior discussion differed from actual FotMob 4-2-3-1; lineup formation and prediction ingestion were not independently certified.
Chelsea-Manchester United kicked off 12:30Z before initial 43-match seal timestamp 13:53Z; this outcome must never enter original Oct 31 prospective slate or its sample counts.

followups.action: Capture and attest immutable official lineup/formation inputs prior to model prediction with source timestamps and lineup guard before release.
Keep halftime goal market probabilities separate from fulltime, and require forward-calibrated interval features and actual synchronized quotes.
For live models, timestamp score, red cards, VAR, current match minute and remaining game time; reject pre-match prices once kickoff passes.
Separate outcome conditional simulations from price-verifiable settled ROI, and track foregone/passed picks with the same as-of time.
